verdict.rationale: Limitless documents a first-party feature to export all of your data and easy in-app deletion of all data. Its Developer API also lets users retrieve lifelogs, chats, and raw Pendant audio, the audio as standard Ogg Opus files without transcoding, which supports open-format portability and leaving. missing for 10: stated file format(s) of the bulk export feature, explicit documentation that transcripts/lifelogs export in an open structured format (e.g. JSON/Markdown), independent or hands-on corroboration that the full export works.
